  "summary": "The unchanged model implementation exactly reproduces all 336 prior graph hashes and 144 baseline mechanical reference rows (zero difference in G0 and retention). Across the 384-case L=24 control matrix, all solves converged (max force residual 3.72e-10), the exponential rate cap (>=30) was never triggered (max uncapped argument 1.046), and all 96 eligible individual time-step refinements met the predeclared |retention(dt=0.05) - retention(dt=0.025)| <= 0.0001 gate (max 9.61e-5). However, numerical adequacy for t=5 retention must be distinguished from physical mechanism and asymptotic accuracy: (1) evaluating retention at t=5 (where baseline stretching relaxation exp(-5)=0.00674 is >99% complete) under small strain (gamma=0.1) structurally bounds the impact of strain-dependent rate acceleration (beta=10 vs 0); (2) the beta=0 rate-control contrast requires bending stiffness (kappa>0), as pure central-force networks (kappa=0) are ineligible (floppy, G0<=1e-6) in the uniform arm at z=3.2 and yield identically zero topology contrast at beta=0 for z=4.0 and 4.8; and (3) first-order O(dt) operator splitting leaves a max paired contrast drift of 1.07e-4 at z=3.2, kappa=0.03, which slightly exceeds 0.0001 but is >2,000x smaller than the hub-minus-uniform effect.",
